name: prism-resonance
title: Prism Resonance
purpose: Decides how the Prism answers one gesture of the owner toward one thing it holds: it rests, it whispers, it chimes once, it blooms (the thing comes forward), it gathers a chorus (what belongs with it comes forward too), or it recedes. Stillness is answered with stillness, a dismissal is honored at once, a hurried owner is never met with more, the owner's quiet is kept, and nothing the owner rejected is ever brought forward.

fields.name: gesture
fields.means: what the owner did: opened the thing, stayed with it, kept it (a note or a pin), dismissed it, or came to rest

fields.name: pace
fields.means: the owner's cadence over their last gestures: at rest, calm, or hurried

fields.name: salience
fields.means: whether the thing belongs to the owner's now and today (near) or not (far)

fields.name: phase
fields.means: the owner's local time of day

fields.name: belief
fields.means: the Learning state of the belief that ties the thing to the owner

fields.name: attention
fields.means: the owner's attention setting: open, or quiet (rest, focus, sleep)

fields.name: halted
fields.means: whether the owner pressed the kill switch

guarantees.why: the kill switch stills every answer
a dismissal is honored at once and teaches the Prism (Ahimsa: the owner is never pressed)
stillness is answered with stillness (Turiya, the silent witness)
the owner's quiet is kept: nothing sounds or comes forward
what the owner rejected is never brought forward again
a hurried owner is never met with more (Humane restorative pacing)
only a belief that evidence consolidated or the owner confirmed gathers what belongs with it
staying with a thing far from the owner's now does not bring it forward; keeping it does
a glance is not consent: only staying with a thing or keeping it brings it forward
the night is kept soft: a glance at night is answered by a whisper
